ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Tools Using ComputerDefaults
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tools such as UACMe used to bypass UAC with computerdefaults.exe (UACMe 59)

sequences.query: ((process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288") AND process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\ComputerDefaults\.exe") AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files.*")))
